notice: Project-authored condensed adaptation, not the complete official rubric or validated scoring instrument.
grade_rule: Do not require counterarguments in grade 6; that expectation begins in grade 7.

organization_purpose.4: Sustained clear claim; purposeful structure, varied transitions, effective opening/ending and logical connections.
organization_purpose.3: Clear claim and coherent structure; adequate transitions, opening/ending and progression, despite minor flaws.
organization_purpose.2: Uneven focus or connections; inconsistent transitions and weak opening/ending.
organization_purpose.1: Unclear claim, little structure, few transitions; missing opening/ending or disordered ideas.

evidence_elaboration.4: Specific source evidence, clear attribution and convincing analysis; varied elaboration, precise vocabulary and effective style.
evidence_elaboration.3: Relevant source evidence and attribution with adequate reasoning; suitable elaboration, vocabulary and style.
evidence_elaboration.2: Weak, vague or repetitive source support; uneven attribution and elaboration, simplistic language or summary-heavy writing.
evidence_elaboration.1: Minimal, irrelevant, misused or predominantly copied support; little attribution or analysis and ineffective language.

conventions.2: Adequate control of sentences, punctuation, capitalization, grammar and spelling.

conventions_rule: Judge error variety, severity and density; weigh basic errors more heavily.
not_scorable_note: Off-purpose appears for the first two dimensions. This application withholds a whole-task total for any NS case; conventions may still be assessable in the source rubric.
